entities.summary: Celtic oppida (Bratislava-Devín), the Boii and Cotini tribes, Roman military presence along the Danube limes (Gerulata, Brigetio), Marcus Aurelius writing Meditations at Carnuntum near the Slovak border, and the inscription at Trenčín (179 CE) — the northernmost Roman inscription in Central Europe.
